channel.title: Jay Respawns — Esports Weekly Feed
channel.description: Aggregated esports news: SEA and global

item.title: FaZe crash out of PGL Major Singapore in Stage 1 as HEROIC beat them again 11 days on
item.description:
HEROIC have sent FaZe Clan home from the PGL Major Singapore 2026 before Stage 2. A side that reached a Major final in 2024 now faces questions about its roster heading into 2027, with captain Twistzz admitting the team has gone backwards.

The post FaZe crash out of PGL Major Singapore in Stage 1 as HEROIC beat them again 11 days on appeared first on Esports Insider.

item.title: 103-year-old grandmother competing in Tekken 8 tournament but doesn’t actually want to win
item.description: A 103-year-old gaming grandmother is taking part in a Tekken tournament, with one of her closest rivals also being 95 years old.

item.title: Fnatic open Valorant rebuild with marteen, who set a kill record against them
item.description:
Fnatic have signed Czech duelist Martin 'marteen' Pátek from Gentle Mates as their first new player for VCT EMEA 2027. The London club are rebuilding after missing Champions for the first time in the team's history.

The post Fnatic open Valorant rebuild with marteen, who set a kill record against them appeared first on Esports Insider.

item.title: Revenant XSpark recover from a map down to beat GOC and set up Kryon Esports rematch
item.description:
GOC Esports took the opening map, but Revenant XSpark won the next two to reach the upper semi-final of the VCT Pacific Kickoff South Asia qualifier playoffs. Kryon Esports are next, with two South Asian places in the Pacific Last Chance Qualifier at stake.

The post Revenant XSpark recover from a map down to beat GOC and set up Kryon Esports rematch appeared first on Esports Insider.

item.title: GodLike Esports sweep Trigger Point Esports to stay unbeaten in South Asia Kickoff qualifier
item.description:
GodLike Esports beat Trigger Point Esports 2-0 in the upper bracket of the VCT Pacific Kickoff South Asia qualifier. Only two South Asian sides will reach the Last Chance Qualifier, where a single place at Kickoff in Bangkok is on offer.

The post GodLike Esports sweep Trigger Point Esports to stay unbeaten in South Asia Kickoff qualifier appeared first on Esports Insider.

item.title: QoR sweep Maryville to reach VCT Americas Kickoff North America playoffs after opening loss
item.description:
QoR's 2-0 win over Maryville University completed a recovery from an opening defeat at the VCT Americas Kickoff North America qualifiers. A Kickoff place and a Red Bull Home Ground spot both stay within QoR's reach as a result.

The post QoR sweep Maryville to reach VCT Americas Kickoff North America playoffs after opening loss appeared first on Esports Insider.

item.title: No Org No Problem beat Stallions Esports 2-1 to reach VCT EMEA Kickoff MENA grand final
item.description:
No Org No Problem won the opening and deciding maps against Stallions Esports to reach the MENA Qualifier Playoffs grand final. One more series win against Mix My Miks would send them to VCT EMEA Kickoff 2027 in Berlin alongside partner teams including Fnatic.

The post No Org No Problem beat Stallions Esports 2-1 to reach VCT EMEA Kickoff MENA grand final appeared first on Esports Insider.

item.title: Shopify Rebellion Black beat Xora 2-0 in opening VCT Americas Kickoff qualifier match
item.description:
Shopify Rebellion Black opened the North America Qualifier Playoffs with a 2-0 win over Xora Esports. The non-partner organisation is now one win from the playoffs that decide a guaranteed São Paulo Kickoff place.

The post Shopify Rebellion Black beat Xora 2-0 in opening VCT Americas Kickoff qualifier match appeared first on Esports Insider.

item.title: Nongshim RedForce sign Deft after military service, reuniting DRX’s 2022 world title trio
item.description:
Nongshim RedForce have brought 2022 world champion Deft back to the LCK and paired him again with Kingen and Pyosik. The move follows an eighth-place 2026 for the club and comes days after BLG ended Korea's four-year hold on the World Championship.

The post Nongshim RedForce sign Deft after military service, reuniting DRX’s 2022 world title trio appeared first on Esports Insider.

item.title: Fnatic confirms Razork exit as Lospa’s SK Gaming move deepens 2027 rebuild
item.description:
Fnatic has confirmed the departure of its longest-serving player, jungler Razork, who is set to join Team Heretics. With support Lospa also set to leave, the London club faces a near-total LEC roster rebuild for 2027.

The post Fnatic confirms Razork exit as Lospa’s SK Gaming move deepens 2027 rebuild appeared first on Esports Insider.

item.title: Caedrel and Dan Gaskin win for Britain at Esports Awards as Counter-Strike 2 takes top game
item.description:
Britain's Marc 'Caedrel' Lamont and Dan Gaskin were among the winners at the 2026 Esports Awards in Miami, where Counter-Strike 2 was named game of the year and Team Vitality and BLAST also took industry honours. The results crown a strong Counter-Strike year eight days before the next CS2 Major begins in Singapore.

The post Caedrel and Dan Gaskin win for Britain at Esports Awards as Counter-Strike 2 takes top game appeared first on Esports Insider.
